text.text:
It's matches like these that really beg the question, what is the point of tournaments like these?

If you really wanted a display of wildcard teams causing an upset, why not direct-invite top 10 vrs, then open qual for the wildcard spots, and run the tournament exactly like Draculan?

Instead, you have FaZe walking out with pity prize money, a meaningless bump to their ranking, and wasted travel time that could have been used for practice. Now granted, the invite for this tournament was sent months ago, and that's not a can of worms I want to open. But to what end, Blast?

Don't even get me started on the fact that this is an 8-team tournament with 6-team playoffs. They had plenty of time after Blast Rivals Hong Kong to change this. If you wanted 8 teams, you should have just started this tournament in an arena like EWC. But nah, let's humiliate some teams while we're at it. Right Blast?

Anyways, I hope FaZe plays a competitive game, and molodoy keeps being molodoy so he can rip this trophy from Vitality's hands.
